Content: The Autopuppets are malfunctioning? How... how is that possible? Could it be false intel?
Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...
The Autopuppets are malfunctioning? How... how is that possible? Could it be false intel?
Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...
There must be thousands of Autopuppets across Xuanfang. If they all go rogue, it'll be a catastrophic threat to everyone living here!
Oh, no... I have to get out of here... To Mengzhou... Wait, no. Jinzhou should be closer...
Use your head! What happens if a rogue Autopuppet catches you the second you leave the village? What about the Tacet Discords? You're not a Resonator, alright?!
Just listen to Liangyu and the others for now...
Ming...! You're hurt?!
Ugh, I'm fine... Just a scratch. Nothing serious, Yan...
Ming...! You're hurt?!
Ugh, I'm fine... Just a scratch. Nothing serious, Yan...
What happened?! You said you were just patrolling the Censure Courts. How could this happen...?
Those Autopuppets... they went crazy out of nowhere. We didn't even have time to react...
I was one of the lucky ones. Liangyu got us out. But so many of our people... They...
Hah... Haha... HAHAHA—I knew it... I KNEW IT!
Not this delusional nonsense again, Digeng...
Hah... Haha... HAHAHA—I knew it... I KNEW IT! There is something wrong with those Autopuppets! They're finally showing their true colors!
Not this delusional nonsense again, Digeng...
Delusional? Me?! No... That night twenty years ago... I'll never forget it... not as long as I live!
It was the Autopuppets... Had to be! They've been playing along all this time! Now everyone finally gets to see what they really are!
Digeng, you're... Haah. I'll go get Changluan to keep an eye on you.
What about those from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs?
With the lockdown lately, there was only a small crew left...
What about those from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs? I thought we put out a notice for everyone to pull back?
With the lockdown lately, there was only a small crew left on duty to keep the Skywatch Rings running.
Honestly, if they hadn't switched the monitors to safety mode, we wouldn't even be able to see the data right now with the comms jammed.
But... because they stayed behind to do that, a few of them missed their chance to evacuate.
By the time we got there... it was already too late.
Excuse me, any word about my husband? He left the village yesterday morning...
I'm sorry...
Excuse me, any word about my husband? He left the village yesterday morning, but he still hasn't returned...
I'm sorry, we haven't seen him either...
But we'll let you know the moment there's news.
Oh, my darling... Please be safe...
Wait... I think I left something at home. I'll go back to get it—
This isn't a picnic! Get to the rally point. NOW!
Gather the villagers in the square. And check every household. We don't want to miss anyone...
Understood. Moving out now.
I can't believe it... Watcher Duzhong, Watcher Qingzhi... They actually...
...Don't think about that right now. Focus on the mission.
A-are you alright?
Ah... aaah—No... everyone...
Everyone is... The Autopuppets... they—
Just... just try to calm down. I'll get you some water, okay?
Still no word from Master Shenyuan?

Still no word from Master Shenyuan?
Yes, and none of the Watchers accompanying him have come back either. I'm worried...
He went to check a Censure Court, which means... it's not just one court being threatened by rogue Autopuppets...
Ha... Master Shenyuan is a man of few words, but his skill and knowledge are undoubtedly the best among us.
Exactly... If only he were here, we might actually stand a chance against these Autopuppets.
How's the situation at the Skyworks right now?
None of the reconnaissance agents we sent have returned...
How's the situation at the Skyworks right now?
None of the reconnaissance agents we sent have returned... The Commander sent his Rafter Kite to take a look. The rogue Autopuppets have almost certainly taken over the whole area.
You mean... even the Myriad Snare has turned against us?
It's... highly likely. The Commander has barred all troops from entering the Skyworks and gave orders to wait for the Paragon's intel before making a move...
I suppose that's all we can do for now...
Is everything alright? Are you injured?
Oh, I'm fine... Thank you. I was just doing routine maintenance when that Autopuppet suddenly went rogue...

O Seeker of the road ahead, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. You've braved tempests, heard the dual nature of Ragunna's faith, and tasted the glory in the arenas of Septimont. Adventuring through the City Set in Amber, you faced deep space in mysterious Lahai-Roi, meeting the Void with courage. Now the road ahead has again revealed itself. Let us return to Huanglong, and journey on to Mengzhou.

In Jinzhou, you joined hands with Jiyan and the other Resonators to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak in Norfall Barrens. You also met "little Abby." You ultimately triumphed over and absorbed the Dreamless.
Under the guidance of the Wayfinder Changli, you resolved the Temporal Disruption at Mt. Firmament. And Sentinel Jué passed the Temporal Mandate on to Magistrate Jinhsi.
When you sought the truth of your own past, you met Shorekeeper in the Black Shores and reclaimed your duty as the organization's leader.

In search of a solution to Abby's deteriorating condition, you crossed the Stormy Sea and arrived in Ragunna, a port city in Rinascita. There, as the Carnevale Laureate, you received a revelation concerning the Sentinel.
Following the clues, you reached the Avinoleum Theological Seminary, hanging inverted in the sky, and there you rescued Cartethyia, vessel of the Threnodian, and Resonator of Imperator.
Next, you traveled to Septimont, where you helped the Gladiator Lupa and the Blessed Maiden Cartethyia foil the Fractsidus's scheme to overwrite Septimont's reality with their script.

In search of the Threnodian's Gem, you came to the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Along the way, you learned of the promise you once made to Phrolova, and the knot it had become in her heart. In the end Fenrico met his end, the Gem fell back into the Fractsidus's hands, and Phrolova sank into the deep, vanishing without a trace.
Afterward, at the invitation of Septimont's Ephor Augusta, you traveled with her to the Sanguis Plateaus, where you watched her prove, through her deeds, what it means to be a true sovereign.
Amid the celebrations, you sensed that something was wrong, investigated alone, and eventually saved Iuno, whose very existence was being erased.

At last, with the support of many companions, you led them to drive back the Threnodian that sought to be reborn. And so Rinascita greeted a dawn with no more divinity, a dawn that belonged to humanity alone.
Bidding farewell to Rinascita, you came next to a ruined city within a Sonoro, Honami City. There you met a girl named Chisa, and together you broke the endlessly looping curse that bound the place.
Then, to address the sudden onset of your own frequency loss, you arrived in Lahai-Roi and met Lynae, a girl with a troubled past. Together you fought off the Voidworm assaulting Startorch Academy.
Next, alongside Mornye, your former junior schoolmate, you averted the crisis of the falling Reactor Drive, and Lahai-Roi saw its "second sunrise."
Later, with the help of the mysterious girl Aemeath, you uncovered the truth behind your frequency loss.

You were surprised to learn that you had once saved Aemeath, and that the two of you had shared a home together. This strong, brave girl inherited your will and chose to sacrifice herself to save the world.
You joined Luuk Herssen in searching for a way to bring Aemeath back, and as you came to know Luuk's past, you also saw through the disguise of the Fractsidus's Grand Architect.
To further thwart the Grand Architect's schemes, you ventured into the Academy's Dark Side with Sigrika, helping her overcome her inner demons while resolving the crisis there.

With the help of all the explorers, the Exostrider obtained a "human heart" and ascended to become a Sentinel, once again banishing the Threnodian Aleph-1 from Solaris. It also gained a name of its own: Lahai-Roi.
In the end, even with the Exostrider gone, you helped Lucilla give the students a new mission—using the technology the Exostrider left behind to break through the Etheric Sea.

It is also worth noting that during your time in Lahai-Roi, you unexpectedly met Lucy and Rebecca from Night City. Together, you fought the Nightmare that pursued them and helped Lucy fulfill a wish along the way...
As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.

Are you alright?
I'm fine... Just been overusing my Forte the last few days. I'm a little tired.
You, on the other hand... You look like you have barely broken a sweat.
Let's just say I got plenty of practice against humanoid weapons back in Lahai-Roi.
What...?
...Compared to everything else, fighting is the easy part.
Just what kind of life have you lived?
These Autopuppet kernels...
Abby.
Yep, what's up?
Want some snacks?
Don't you think it looks like a gaint piece of candy?
Nooooo—! Absolutely not! It looks nasty!
My stomach isn't a trash can!
This may help us locate Yangyang.
You can analyze its frequency.
Ugh, fine, if you say so... I'll do it.
It's all for Yangyang, okay? Even if I get a stomachache, I'll still do it—!
Bleh... That tasted awful.
What did you "taste"?
Well, I'm not sure how to put it... The frequency was messy, like a billion math formulas all tangled together. Looking at it makes my head hurt.
What if it's the core programming driving the Autopuppets?
Yeah, and?
It's weird... On top of that string of numbers, there's a ton of... emotions.
Rage, regret, disappointment...
A machine... isn't supposed to have emotions.
Could that be what's causing them to go rogue?
Blegh... Too much bad juju... My stomach's feeling all kinds of wrong.
I'm out. Gotta crash for a bit... Wake me if something goes down.
To investigate, you have Abby consume an Autopuppet's kernel. Surprisingly, beyond the original data and frequency, the kernel is warped with intense negative emotions.
(Were those emotions implanted? Or...)
Sorry, but... What was that thing back there?
Hm? You mean Abby? That's my Echo. It has a big appetite.
(I guess I'd better not pry...)
For an Autopuppet kernel to possess emotions similar to those of people... I've never heard of such a thing.
For the Ministry of Development, Autopuppet technology and the Hold itself both originated from the Sentinel's black box.
You mentioned earlier that the Sentinel of Mengzhou is missing?
Well, she holds a residence in Xuanfang Hold, but the doors have not opened in a long time.
The Warden Commander tried to contact her many times, but received no response.
We're missing too many pieces of the puzzle at this point in time.
Agreed. Let's hope we find some clues at the Skyworks.
These are... Someone fought an entire squad of Autopuppets here.
The traces on the remains... It was Yangyang.
Really...! Then we should be able to track the frequency she left behind.
(Hang on, Yangyang... I'm almost there.)
The fighting stretched all the way here...
Yangyang... She did this alone.
Watch out—! These things aren't dead yet!
Someone treated their wounds here... It must be Yangyang. She's injured.
It must not have been too serious. She doesn't appear to have stayed long.
How many Autopuppets did she fight... They do attack humans sometimes, but she doesn't seem like the type to provoke them.
She must've found something... Maybe the source of the Autopuppet rebellion.
These tracks... It's a Cloud Ride. She took one to the Skyworks.
Let's keep moving.
The wind...
Yangyang's doing. She left it for us.
This is Yangyang's...
How unexpected. Uninvited guests... at a time like this.
Let me guess... it was that foolish girl's Rafter Kite that led you here?
Who are—
Hmm... a Watcher who slipped the net. It seems I miscalculated the Paragon's capabilities.
You...
Where's Yangyang?!
Yangyang... So that is her name.
Answer me!
I won't ask twice.
A shame, really. She could have contributed to my grand experiment. Instead, she chose... the path of self-destruction.
Interesting... Black hair. Golden eyes. You match the description given by the woman in red.
Such a shame. You fancy yourself a hero, but you are too late. Far too late.
The experiment is nearing its final stage. Soon, Xuanfang Hold, this little "toy box" of the Sentinel, will finally realize its true value.
This is... Yangyang's Cloud Ride.
But... where is she?

Following Yangyang's trail deep into the Skyworks, you find a destroyed Cloud Ride and her hat. Just as you plan your next move, you cross paths with Muyu, who is attempting to flee the facility. He reveals that Yangyang is in grave danger. Enraged, you move to apprehend him, but he escapes into the depths of the Skyworks.
Tch—
Come on... What else can we use—?!
That man—he's the mastermind behind the Autopuppet rebellion?!
Hurry! We can't let him get away!
Just now... He spoke like he knew you. Have you met him before?
No, I don't think so.
(The woman in red... Did he mean a Fractsidus Overseer?)
Those people over there...
How dare they use Censure Cages on civilians!
We need to get them out.
Oh, thank the heavens... Thank the heavens! I thought my time had come.
Are you... Uncle Dong from Jinzhou?
Eh? Y-y-you... aren't you {PlayerName}? Oh, what a relief! Everyone, {PlayerName} has come to save us!
Are you the ones Yangyang was looking for? The missing people from Jinzhou?
Young Yangyang!? She's here too?
How were you captured?
That... Oh! Long story short, I was on my way to Mengzhou to visit family. When I passed through Xuanfang, I ran into a group of masked brigands.
Ah...! And it was not just us. They seemed to have seized folks from all over these lands.
Demons take him—what's that man plotting?
Is there anyone else trapped here?
Oh, yes, yes! You must hurry! They've been taking people deeper into the factory, and no one ever comes back.
We will do everything we can.

As you pursue Muyu, you rescue Uncle Dong, who was kidnapped and brought to Xuanfang. He tells you and Liangyu that all the missing citizens from Jinzhou have been imprisoned in the Skyworks by unidentified thugs.
So relentless... Do you truly believe your actions can change anything? That unfounded confidence is simply arrogance wearing a mask.
If you posed even the smallest threat to my plan, would I have let you come this far?
A ghost that will not rest—
But even a variable like you still falls within my margins.
You wish to charge at windmills? Very well. I will indulge you.
Go on. Strike it. Break it. Tell yourself you are saving something. It will be your only triumph.
Yangyang...!
I had no idea... You and the Sentinel of Mengzhou shared such a complicated history.

I'm sorry, {PlayerName}, for keeping this from you. My deal with Hsin was meant to stay between us. Until I stood before Her, I wasn't sure if revealing the truth would help or just make things worse.
Thank you for finding Yangyang. In the end, I wasn't much help in that department.
Don't say that, Suisui. It's over now. You've carried that burden alone for far too long.
We wouldn't have made it out of the Skyworks without your help.
In any case, the Sentinel's token has passed into your hands. That means your fate is now woven with Hsin the Moon Fox. When those threads will come undone, I cannot say.
Would not be the first time.
If She's in trouble, I won't just stand by.
Before that, we have to stop the Autopuppet rebellion.
Sister, you mentioned Zhuojun Atelier. Did you find something specific about them back in Mengzhou?
They are a unique organization renowned for their mastery of mechanist art. Their roots run deep in Mengzhou, and their expertise rivals that of Huaxu Academy.
But they lack discipline and have no unified code of conduct. Their leader, the Grand Helm "Flowerveil Puppet," is especially elusive, with questionable morals.
You both know of the <te href=750057>Séance Society</te>, yes? Though it has since disbanded, their leader, the <te href=750058>Dollmaker</te>, was originally from Zhuojun Atelier.
(The Séance Society...)
(Yinlin...)
That man, Muyu... he was a member of the Atelier two hundred years ago. But it seems he's long since cut ties with them.
Two hundred years ago... Even for a Resonator, that is an exceptionally long life. He might've had multiple identities in that time. Tracing his origins will prove difficult.
There's something else. He knew me. The way he spoke... he knows my history.
And he mentioned a "woman in red"...
Could it be the woman we encountered in Jinzhou? Scar's companion?
Zhuojun Atelier and the Fractsidus... If he has ties to both...
With a Forte we don't yet understand, infiltrating the Autopuppet system and causing the chaos in Xuanfang would be well within his reach.
But... why? He kept mentioning his "experiment." What could it mean?
It might be related to what he took from the Skyworks.
He's probably using the Reverberation for something.
At least now we know who we need to stop.
Let's find Liangyu and the Warden Commander. Maybe they can help us make sense of these leads.
No, I don't think it's her... It sounds like an Overseer we haven't met yet. Someone still lurking in Huanglong.
I can feel it, though... She's hiding something. A truth She cannot, or will not, speak. You will have to find that answer yourself.

You, Yangyang, and Suisui exchange the intel you have gathered. Piecing the clues together, Suisui believes that Zhuojun Atelier, a prominent Automata Mechanics organization based in Mengzhou, is heavily implicated. To gather more evidence, you seek out the Warden Commander and Liangyu.
By the way, earlier, I asked Abby to "analyze" the abnormal Autopuppet's kernel.
It was packed with negative emotions. If those were somehow implanted from the outside...
That could be how Muyu is controlling them...
(But the source of those emotions... Could it be...)
These Autopuppets... What in the heavens could have caused this?
These Autopuppets... What in the heavens could have caused this?
With our current skills, we can inspect their mechanical structures and make simple repairs, but we cannot begin to understand their control kernels...
Hm? You...
(Tell him about Muyu)
Muyu? No one by that name works here. But the man you're describing... that sounds exactly like Master Shenyuan.
He came to us twenty years ago. One of our most senior Artisans.
He keeps to himself, but his skills are exceptional. We all trust him. A few days ago, he stopped showing up. We thought he had fallen victim to the rogue Autopuppets...
You think... he's been plotting this for the past twenty years? No, that cannot be...
He never said a word about Zhuojun Atelier. We used to discuss techniques together. I thought I knew him well...
Why... why would he do this...?
Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?
Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?
All accounted for... I still cannot wrap my head around it. I saw my own work—the transmission lever I just fixed.
Keep a close watch on them. We will need to give an account for this later.
To others... and to ourselves.
Without the Autopuppets, how are we supposed to stop the Tacet Discords?
We have to trust the Wardens.
Those two over there... who are they?
I heard they are reinforcements from Jinzhou. The Ministry of War has been greatly aided by them.
But there's... only two of them...
...Check the Ministry of War, the Ministry of Development, and Huaxu Academy. If there's any space left, get the elderly and children in first.

When the last civilian is inside the Hold, recall the remainder of our forces. Leave only a handful of scouts. The Autopuppets within the city remain operational, but watch them closely. Do not let them fight. Not until we know why this is happening.
Understood. I will send someone at once—Oh, you're here.
I assume this is the Warden Commander?
(He's not quite what I expected...)
...You three must be the ones Liangyu spoke of. In these desperate hours, your willingness to stand with us is a comfort beyond words. I, Qiuhong, owe you a debt!
Commander Qiuhong, there are things we need to discuss with you and Liangyu.
I have just finished our next deployment schedule. We can talk at the Ministry of War.
You mean... someone saved you from a rogue Autopuppet?
Yes... but I couldn't see their face. They wore a hat.
In times like these... who could it have been?
The group arrives at the Ministry of War to exchange the intelligence they have gathered.
So, this Muyu... spent years disguised as a Ministry Artisan, all to lay hands on the Sentinel's technology... That was a grave oversight on our part.
And since Zhuojun Atelier never discloses its members' identities, I fear tracing his origins will lead nowhere...
However, if one digs deeper, the Atelier's connection to Xuanfang Hold runs deeper than most realize.
What do you mean?

I discovered the connection in a dossier collected by the Commanders who came before me. Everyone knows when the Threnodian stirred at Norfall Barrens and Tacet Discords swelled beyond control, Sentinel Hsin looked ahead. She chose to build this Hold.
But She did not build it alone. No. She needed hands and sought out a council of helpers.

Back then, Zhuojun Atelier had already stood in Mengzhou for generations. Masters of the mechanist arts. Architects of <ano=Abyssal>Yuan</ano> Fortress. So when the call went out, they answered. They wished to take on the commission for Xuanfang.
Yet for some unknown reason... the Sentinel passed them over.
Who did Hsin choose to assist in the construction instead?
I remember Xiangli Yao telling me that a group from the Court of Savantae once came to Mengzhou...
Exactly. They were the ones who helped build the Hold, but no records of their whereabouts were found afterward.
Could it be... that the Atelier has held a grudge against the Sentinel and Xuanfang Hold after being turned down?
To wait two hundred years for revenge? That Muyu is certainly patient, if nothing else.
No... While I can't say for sure, I believe his motives run deeper than a simple grudge.
Manipulating the Autopuppets to cause chaos may only be one step in his plan. So far, only one place in Xuanfang remains untouched by rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords...
...The Hold itself.
Given the sheer value this Hold represents to this land, it's only natural that he would set his sights on it.
Regardless, we must stand ready to fight. Perhaps... without hope of aid. A fight to the death against rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords.
Count me in the fight.
We stand together, no matter what.
Our people have guarded this Hold for over two centuries...
I hope that its history does not end with us.

Communication across Xuanfang has been severed by unknown interference. Fortunately, the Ministry of Development has just finished a batch of signal nodes. Once we place them around the Hold, they will restore our internal comms and link directly to the defense systems.
This will aid our defense. But we are short on hands... {PlayerName}, would you help set up some of the nodes?
No problem.
Consider it done.
I'll go with you, {PlayerName}.

According to the Warden Commander, the Court of Savantae was the last faction involved in building Xuanfang Hold two centuries ago. But regardless of the mysteries weaving these events together, you must brace yourselves for an imminent siege.
While you set up the nodes, how about I stay here at the Hold to keep an eye on things?
The people you rescued from the Skyworks were brought here as well, weren't they? I'll go check on their condition.
Thank you.
I just remembered... I need to return this sword to the villagers...
That so?
It's a long story. A local I met earlier asked me to keep it for them.
It's just... I don't know why, but I feel a strange familiarity with it.
Looking at its edges, I've even started to see things. Flashes of the past.
Like the visions I had when I saw Jué's statue?
But that was because of the history you shared with Jué.
I have never set foot in the Land of Xuanfang before...
What if you've lost your memories too, like I did?
{PlayerName}... Really now? How could that be...?
(Yeah. That... probably couldn't be true.)
Lady Hsin... Why has She not appeared...
It's been too long since we last saw Her...
But... but...
I refuse to believe She would simply abandon us...
How's that boy Qingyan doing?
How's that boy Qingyan doing?
The Huaxu researchers say his condition is stable now. He just needs rest. That sudden Resonance Awakening took a lot out of him.
Thank goodness... If not for that power, he and his sister would have fallen from the cliff.
There. The two nodes we were assigned are in place...
We still have a bit of time. Let's go find the village chief.
What was that...
{PlayerName}...?
I heard someone singing...
Is this what you spoke about before...
Xuanfang Hold... It's like... we're in the past again.
This song...
Let's find out where it's coming from, {PlayerName}.
Did you hear it too, {PlayerName}?
If it isn't Yangyang! You returned unharmed!
Yes, I'm fine. Thank you for your concern.
Your safe return... your safe return is all that matters...
I brought back the blade you entrusted to Liangyu. There was... some trouble along the way, but I managed to keep it safe.
This is... ah, thank you. Thank you.
No thanks are needed, Chief. As I said, this blade gives the courage to walk forward even in the face of death.
It... will bear witness as we weather this storm together.

In the Hold, you and Yangyang meet the chief of Xianling Village and return the longsword to him. But as you place the sword back onto the altar, a familiar song echoes behind you, pulling you and Yangyang into a Sonoro Sphere.
Could these be... Xuanling Birds?
I didn't think I'd ever get to see them...
(...Why... when I see them... do I have this feeling like...?)
Ah... a miscalculation.
A miscalculation... a miscalculation.
Only a single lost piece. What settles the game lies not on the board, but with us.
A lifetime of playing the board. And now, it seems... I am a piece on it myself.
You old hack. That last move was the finest of your sorry life.
Promise me you will eat well. Sleep well...
Snff... Snff...
What else... Ah, yes. Just stay safe, okay?
Wait for my return. But if I do not... wait for the Ministry's letter.
Oh, Xuanling... Will the Sword Transcendent finally descend from the mountain this time?
Could you tell her how my greatest wish has always been to become her disciple?
I'll be leaving soon, Xuanling.
Now now, don't be so stubborn. Beyond Xuanfang, there are oh so many melodies waiting for you...
Hm?
You are... Liangyu?
Liangyu? Liang... Yu... Hmm. A beautiful name, but it is not mine.
My name is Lingfang. Are you new recruits as well? Heh, the Ministry must truly be in dire straits if they cannot even give you proper uniforms.
(She's the one I saw in those memories. She and Liangyu... Could it be...)
If I remember correctly, you were once... a musician?
Oh? I did not expect to be recognized so far from Mengzhou.
A shame I cannot play for you now. I have already sold my <ano=stringed instrument>liuqin</ano>. No place for music on a battlefield.
Why did you join the army...
No grand reason. Tacet Discords killed my beloved. So I took up a blade to avenge him. It is as simple as that.

My father served in Mengzhou's Ministry of War. He taught me how to fight when I was young, but I grew bored after a few years and ran away to study music. It was during those wandering years that I met him.

Others might have seen only an ordinary painter, but I saw the colors within him. He walked away from a chance to study at the Mingting Institute of Art, all to stay in the hometown he loved so dearly.
He loved painting the Xuanling Birds. They were his voice. They helped him confess what he was too shy to say to me himself.
But it's all gone now. Tacet Discords took everything.
The thought of those monsters coming here to trample the land he held so dear...
Makes me... tremble with rage.
So I took up the sword again, just like my father had always wished. He used to say a sword is wielded for one's country and people. I still don't think I understand what that means.
...They're the same thing.
Whether it's for a person, an ideal, or something more profound that's hard to put in words...
We feel for the things we hold dear. Sorrow. Joy. Fear. Shame. Anger.
That is why we choose to protect.
And you're protecting more than the memories you made with him. You're protecting the place where countless new memories and feelings will be born.
Protect, you say... We have a baby girl, and I... I only wish I could protect her as she grows.
Don't worry, she will grow up healthy and safe.
She will find her own love, career, and family, and she will protect her child with the same love you gave her. That will pass on, for generations.
To the future and to faraway tomorrows we can't yet see.
I see...
Then... I will hold onto that hope.
I must go. Though I do not know your name, it was a comfort to speak with you before I march onto the battlefield.
I have nothing to offer you in return, so... I give you my song.
The only thing I kept was this <ano=bamboo flute>xiao</ano>. My husband made it for me. I could not bear to part with it.
It never made a single note, but I never told him. That lumbering man was never good with his hands...

Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see the memories of Lingfang, Liangyu's ancestor from two hundred years ago. Her husband had been killed by Tacet Discords, and she was about to march onto the battlefield. Before departing, she sang the familiar song once more as a thank-you to Yangyang for comforting her.
{PlayerName}! Yangyang! Can you hear me?
The last node is in place. Communications around Xuanfang Hold should be fully restored.
We have mobilized all functional heavy siege weapons from the reserves, and Commander Qiuhong has completed the defensive deployment.
However... the enemy moves faster than we anticipated.
No time to explain. Meet me at the front gate!
Let's go, {PlayerName}.
It's our turn to protect this land now.
No... We can't let them reach the Hold!
Go reinforce the other units...
There are too many of them...
The frontline... leave it to me.
Too many. If they break through here... the Hold falls.
Hsin the Moon Fox... Lend me your strength now!
({PlayerName} is taking the brunt of it...)
(I will not be another one {Male=he;Female=she} has to carry!)
(Need to push harder... Need to be stronger!)
(I will... protect everyone!)
So this is what they call a battlefield...
(Yangyang... she's been fighting in places like this all along...)
Thank you! That was a great help!
{PlayerName}! Are you alright?!
These things... Cut down one wave, and another rises to take its place...
Stay focused! We need to survive this wave!
...The moment has come.
Let's bring this "experiment"... to its end.
Muyu... he's probably hiding in that one.
The assault grows fiercer by the moment. My sword formations will not hold long. We must end this quickly.
If you can find the one pulling the strings... go. Strike the root of this evil.
The Paragon is right. Yangyang, {PlayerName}, you two go. We will manage here.
...This ground will hold while you are gone. That is a promise!
...I know. Let's go, {PlayerName}!
Yangyang!
...Be careful.
Paragon Qingxiao?!
Forgive me. I should have come sooner.
The Censure Court... it's growing...

The tide of battle turns when Qingxiao, the Xuan Paragon previously held captive in a Censure Court, breaks free to reinforce the front lines. Just then, an anomaly erupts from a nearby court. After a brief discussion, you and Yangyang head into the court to face the one behind the crisis: Muyu.
(The Streams' Resonance is getting stronger...)
W-what is happening—?
...Votary of the Voice. Do you finally understand?
Who... Who are you?
Even if the choice before you is but a single stone cast into a boundless ocean...
The "ripples" it creates shall touch the fate of the entire <ano=planet>world</ano>.
Turn back here. Leave what follows to ■■■, and you may remain in ignorant bliss, living only for "yourself."
Once this "wind" rises, it will never cease.
I'm sorry. I don't understand what you're saying...
But no matter what, I won't let {Male=him;Female=her} face this alone.
Is that so...
Forgive us. We never intended for any living soul to hear this Voice.
For in every ending, not one has ever succeeded in saving anything.
Will this time be different? We do not know.
If this is your will, your wish, and the path you have chosen...
Then steel yourself... to leave everything behind.
...No. It's nothing.
Let's go, {PlayerName}. Together, we will...
What's wrong, Yangyang?
End it. End it all.

As you step into the malfunctioning Censure Court, a mysterious silhouette manifests before Yangyang. Addressing her as the "Votary of the Voice," the figure warns her to turn back, stating that continuing down this path means embarking on a point of no return, one that demands she give up everything. Refusing to let you face the danger alone, Yangyang chooses to stand by your side.
Oh? Having chased me here, did you enjoy this little game of pretend? And you—I wonder where you picked up that sickening habit of playing human.
I don't know how you've managed to control the Autopuppets...
But you'd better make them stop right now.
No, there's no question that the Autopuppets are functioning exactly as they should. How could a mere mortal like me command the Sentinel's creations?
...Liar. If not for your interference, how could the Sentinel's constructs ever harm the very people they were built to protect?
Heh... Sentinels protecting humans... What an absurd delusion.

Is it because they guide civilization? Because the Sentinels of Huanglong reign alongside humans? You're from Jinzhou, aren't you? Did that girl who became the Sentinel's Resonator feed you that pretty fantasy?
We know nothing of the Sentinels. Not their design, not their internal structure, not where they obtained knowledge that eclipses all human understanding.
Is "protect humanity" written into their core code? Has a single Sentinel ever confirmed it to you?
No. That idea is rooted only in shallow experience, in the numbness of those who have grown comfortable under borrowed protection.
Sentinels... Why do they guide us? And to what end? No one knows.
You cling to this notion that they protect us, because of what? Because they have grown to "feel" for us?
...And what if they have?
Every Sentinel I've met has sacrificed everything for the people under their watch.
You dragging their names in the dirt won't change that.
Hah... "Feeling." If you want to say the world indeed walks on ice this thin...
Then my work here is proof of how easily that feeling can curdle into carnage and suffering.
Kill... Kill all of you... Tacet Discords... Rot in hell...
Spare no one... Do not let any escape...!
Those voices...?!
It took me two centuries to learn how to shape these useless passions into something useful.
I have to admit, the process was not without its pleasures.
I simply altered the <ano=parameters>perception</ano> of these Reverberations. Redirected their rage. Not at the Tacet Discords, but at humanity itself. Then I installed them into the Autopuppets.
And just like that, the protectors become the butchers. A single thread of foolish obsession is enough to shatter every line of logic, every careful protocol.
Feeling... is this dangerous. The enemy of reason. The wellspring of chaos. Humans must learn to control it... No, to discard it entirely.
...You're wrong.
When the ones we love are taken, and our homes are trampled... when a parent realizes they will never watch their child grow, or a peaceful soul is forced to pick up a blade just to survive...
Of course we grieve. Of course we resent. Of course we rage.
Humans are not puppets. From the moment we're born, we find our own "voice."
Whether it laughs or weeps, roars or wails... those voices make up the colors of this world.
But you... you twist them. Mock them. Treat them as tools. You will never understand what they truly mean.
You are nothing but a coward covering his ears! A madman worshipping his own delusions as truth!
You pride yourself on seeing through everything, but you're a greater fool than any you scorn.
And before this is over...
You will be eaten by the very "rage" you created.

Deep within the Censure Court, you confront Muyu. He rants about his distrust of Sentinels and his rejection of human emotion, unveiling the truth behind the Autopuppet uprising. Refuting his twisted theory, you and Yangyang face Muyu's creation—the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion, a colossus powered by the Reverberations of countless fallen souls. To stop Muyu, you must shatter this distorted manifestation of his will.
The simple addition of one superfluous thread, and the perfect guardian becomes a fearsome executioner in an instant.
You still don't get it, do you? You don't believe, that's all. So you're desperate to be right and lord it above everyone else.
What you have done... is not worth the breath it would take to refute it!
If the Sentinels protect humanity only because they "feel," then one day, one moment, one of them could "feel" differently and do the opposite.
These Reverberations have echoed in the abyss for two hundred years. Even now, their remnants serve my purpose.
Isn't it ironic that the very voices you resonate with and mourn for are burying you alive?
Stopped already? Feeling pity for these Reverberations?
Heh... So this is what your so-called "rage" looks like.
Kill... Kill all of you... Tacet Discords... Rot in hell...
Damn you... Tacet Discords...
Must... Kill them... Every last one...
(Draw your sword.)
(Stay your hand.)
Tacet Discords! Tacet Discords! You damned Tacet Discords...!
A hundred times... A thoudsand times... I'll keep killing you all!
No... don't...
Please...
Kill... me...
I have nothing to offer you in return, so... I give you my song.
This... power...?
I knew it. You truly are special...
I failed to claim your Reverberation at the Skyworks, but it is not too late...
...In your dreams!
You will never... toy with another soul again!
{PlayerName}!
Yangyang, you look...
Everyone... entrusted their final voices to me.
Let's... guide them to the end, {PlayerName}.
Two hundred years of Xuanfang's history breathes through us—
It's almost impressive that you two held your own against the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion for this long...
